profile.title: The New Dynamics of Strategy
profile.canonical_definition: 2003 article by Cynthia F. Kurtz and David J. Snowden connecting narrative, sense-making and Cynefin dynamics in complex and complicated contexts.
profile.summary: The New Dynamics of Strategy is an early co-authored scholarly account of narrative, sense-making and movement among Cynefin contexts.
profile.why_it_matters: It grounds both the collaborative development and the dynamic, rather than merely classificatory, character of early Cynefin practice.
common_misreadings: the diagram is the whole argument
